summary: Preliminary proposal to resolve PyLance 6.x compatibility issue in write_lance caused by the removal of the storage_options_provider argument.
assumptions: Actual source files were not provided in the prompt, so exact existing code cannot be shown and proposed code is preliminary.
PyLance 6.x (or 0.6.x+) removed the storage_options_provider keyword argument from its dataset writing API.
Ray Data's write_lance implementation needs to conditionally handle or omit storage_options_provider when invoking PyLance.

changes.purpose: Update parameter handling in write_lance to maintain compatibility with PyLance 6.x.
changes.after:
# Preliminary pseudocode:
import inspect
import lance

# Safely handle storage_options_provider parameter based on PyLance API support
sig = inspect.signature(lance.write_dataset)
kwargs = dict(kwargs)
if "storage_options_provider" in kwargs and "storage_options_provider" not in sig.parameters:
    kwargs.pop("storage_options_provider", None)
changes.explanation: Inspects the signature of lance.write_dataset or checks PyLance version to prevent passing storage_options_provider when unsupported in PyLance 6.x.
